import sys, time, numpy as np, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import te.engine.qp as QP
counts=[]
orig=QP._active_set
def wrap(*a,**k):
    t=time.time(); r=orig(*a,**k); counts.append(time.time()-t)
    return r
QP._active_set=wrap
from te.engine.qp import solve_qp

def build(ncom, slots_per, mode, caps, demands, B, rho, identical=True, seed=0):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    E=len(caps)
    base=[[rng.randrange(E)] for _ in range(slots_per)]
    paths=[]
    for k in range(ncom):
        paths.append([list(p) for p in base] if identical else [[rng.randrange(E)] for _ in range(slots_per)])
    var=[(k,p) for k in range(ncom) for p in range(slots_per)]
    A=np.zeros((E,len(var)))
    for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
        e=paths[k][p][0]
        A[e, j] = 1.0/caps[e]
    Q=np.eye(len(var))+rho*(A.T@A)
    q=-rho*(A.T@np.array(B,dtype=float))
    if mode=='admit': q=q-1.0
    m=ncom
    C=np.zeros((m,len(var))); d=np.array([demands]*m,dtype=float)
    for i in range(m):
        for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
            if k==i: C[i,j]=1.0
    eq=[mode=='route']*m
    x0=np.zeros(len(var))
    if mode=='route':
        for i in range(m):
            v=d[i]/slots_per
            for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
                if k==i: x0[j]=v
    return Q,q,C,d,eq,x0

caps8=[1.0]*8
scenarios=[
    ("sym route cap1", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route cap1 rho1", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,1)),
    ("sym admit cap1", build(24,4,'admit',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route bigB", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1000.0,[500.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route tinyB", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1000.0,[-500.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route d1", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("rand route", build(24,4,'route',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8,identical=False)),
    ("rand admit", build(24,4,'admit',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8,identical=False,seed=3)),
    ("sym route 8 slots", build(12,8,'route',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym admit 8 slots", build(12,8,'admit',caps8,1000.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route mixed caps", build(24,4,'route',[1.0,2.0,3.0,100.0,1.0,7.0,50.0,9.0],100.0,[0.0]*8,8)),
]
for name,(Q,q,C,d,eq,x0) in scenarios:
    counts.clear()
    t=time.time()
    x,lam,ok=solve_qp(Q,q,C,d,eq,x0)
    dt=time.time()-t
    n=len(q); m=len(d)
    g=Q@x+q; nu=g+C.T@lam
    bad=[]
    if n and x.min()<-1e-9: bad.append('neg')
    for i in range(n):
        if x[i]<=0 and nu[i]<-1e-7: bad.append('nu%d=%g'%(i,nu[i]))
    for k in range(m):
        if eq[k] and abs(C[k]@x-d[k])>1e-6: bad.append('eq%d'%k)
        if not eq[k]:
            if C[k]@x>d[k]+1e-6: bad.append('in%d'%k)
            if lam[k]<-1e-9: bad.append('lam%d'%k)
    print("%-24s n=%3d m=%2d %.3fs ok=%s solves=%d bad=%s"%(name,n,m,dt,ok,len(counts),bad[:3]))
EOF
